Editorial Note This is a digital reproduction of “Conditional Relations, Vol. I”, a translation of the ﬁrst chapters of the seventh and last book of the Abhidhamma—the Pat.t.h¯ana—by U N¯arada, assisted by U Thein Nyun, which was ﬁrst published in 1969. While I tried to be as faithful to the original as possible, some changes were introduced: • Pali terms were italicized. • Abbreviations were expanded where space allowed. • A bibliography with links to archive.org—where available—was added. • A huge footnote was moved from the end of the Introduction to its proper place. • The Pali-English Glossary at the end of Volume II was split between the two volumes. • The table of contents was moved to the front of the book. • Large and fold out charts were placed at the end of the book. The pagination of the original PTS edition can be found on the margins. Unless the page begins on a new paragraph, a vertical bar indicates the beginning of the new page. Please mail errors to verein@abhidhamma.de. Lots of thanks go to Ven. Sayalay Piyadass¯ı and Ariya Baumann for the proofreading! Manfred Wierich Hamburg July 2021
